# Diamond Gate Display Continuity Constitution v1

Status: `ACTIVE_MANDATORY_DEVELOPMENT_CONTEXT`

Purpose: define the physical, visual, interaction, runtime, and continuity laws that every new or materially renewed Diamond Gate Bridge project must consider before construction. This constitution is global development context, not global layout authority.

It is subordinate to the existing whole-estate narrative constitution and narrative continuity map:

- `control-plane/whole-estate/narrative-spine-constitution-v1/narrative-spine.v1.json`
- `control-plane/whole-estate/narrative-continuity-development-map-v1/map.v1.json`

It does not make every room look alike, change scientific standing, create claim authority, create project authority, or force all routes into one runtime.

## Authority separation

`COMPASS = GLOBAL_ORIENTATION_AND_NARRATIVE_ANCHOR`

`GOVERNANCE = PUBLIC_INFORMATION_DESIGN_AND_BOUNDED_INTERACTION_REFERENCE`

`EVIDENCE = CLAIM_AND_PROOF_ANCHOR`

`LAWS = RUNTIME_AND_SEMANTIC_CEILING_SOURCE`

No one of these authorities absorbs the others.

## Estate thesis

`THE_ESTATE_SHOULD_FEEL_PERSISTENT`

The target is not a collection of independent microsites. The target is a persistent digital estate in which movement, object identity, orientation, and return remain intelligible across rooms while each room retains its own local identity.

## Display laws

1. `ONE_ESTATE_MANY_ROOMS` — local identity remains real; no universal template may flatten the estate.
2. `COMPASS_OWNS_GLOBAL_ORIENTATION` — no page, door, room, world, product, or project may invent competing cardinal meaning.
3. `LOCAL_DOMAIN_AUTHORITY_MAY_OUTRANK_COMPASS_ONLY_LOCALLY` — a room may be denser or more authoritative inside its declared domain without becoming the whole estate.
4. `PERSIST_SEMANTIC_OBJECT_IDENTITY_WHEN_CONTINUITY_ADDS_MEANING` — continuity may preserve the Compass, threshold, map, gem, Earth, or other meaningful object across transitions.
5. `PERSISTENCE_DOES_NOT_REQUIRE_ONE_RENDERER` — semantic object continuity may cross runtime boundaries; one giant permanent WebGL shell is not required.
6. `TRANSITIONS_REPRESENT_MOVEMENT_NOT_DECORATION` — transition design must communicate arrival, direction, relation, state, pressure, consequence, or return.
7. `MOTION_MUST_REVEAL_MEANING` — decorative motion alone cannot justify runtime cost.
8. `DISPLAY_CEILING_IS_ROUTE_SPECIFIC` — the permitted rendering level is a ceiling, not a requirement.
9. `COMPLEXITY_IS_DISCLOSED_NOT_DUMPED` — progressive disclosure is preferred when simultaneous complexity obscures the next meaningful decision.
10. `MOBILE_IS_A_DISTINCT_COMPOSITION` — tablet and phone layouts are designed intentionally rather than treated as reduced desktop canvases.
11. `REDUCED_MOTION_PRESERVES_COMPLETE_SEMANTICS` — every meaning-bearing state and route must remain available without advanced motion.
12. `PROOF_SURFACES_FAVOR_PRECISION_OVER_SPECTACLE` — Evidence, Governance, Laws, and related proof surfaces may remain visually restrained when restraint improves answerability.
13. `WORLD_SURFACES_MAY_FAVOR_IMMERSION_OVER_DOCUMENT_STRUCTURE` — story and world routes may legitimately use deeper spatial presentation within their runtime ceiling.
14. `VISUAL_POLISH_NEVER_CREATES_CLAIM_AUTHORITY` — presentation cannot upgrade evidence, scientific standing, award status, certification, or product truth.
15. `EVERY_DEEP_MOVEMENT_PRESERVES_EXPLICIT_RETURN` — visitors must be able to recover orientation without relying on browser history or memory.
16. `DISCOVERY_REVEALS_DEPTH_NOT_ANOTHER_DIRECTION` — hidden spaces or easter-egg mechanics may reveal deeper layers but may not silently alter the public cardinal map.
17. `VISUAL_CONTINUITY_MUST_PRESERVE_NARRATIVE_CONTINUITY` — a seamless transition is invalid if it implies the wrong semantic relationship between rooms.
18. `ADVANCED_RUNTIME_MUST_DEGRADE_GRACEFULLY` — the estate remains legible, navigable, and semantically complete when advanced rendering is unavailable.

## Runtime ceiling classes

- `L0_STATIC_TYPOGRAPHIC` — document and information surfaces with no required continuous motion.
- `L1_LIGHT_MOTION` — bounded transitions, reveal states, atmosphere, and low-cost interaction.
- `L2_INTERACTIVE_OBJECT` — meaningful interactive object or stateful presentation without a persistent world runtime.
- `L3_PERSISTENT_SPATIAL_SCENE` — spatial continuity or persistent scene objects where movement itself carries meaning.
- `L4_WORLD_GAME_RUNTIME` — game/world systems whose core purpose requires sustained simulation or immersive spatial runtime.

A route assigned ceiling `Ln` may use any lower level. Higher runtime is never required merely because it is permitted.

Indicative defaults:

- Governance / Evidence / Laws: `L0-L1`
- Build / Products: `L1-L2`
- Compass / Door / Home: `L2-L3`
- Showroom / Awards: `L1-L3` depending on local role
- Mirrorland / game / world routes: `L3-L4`

These are defaults, not immutable classifications. Any elevation must be justified by the local route contract.

## Route display contract

Before any new page, frontier, room, product, world, campaign, or material renewal proceeds to visual construction, the developing agent must resolve:

1. `LOCAL_IDENTITY` — what this route is for independent of the rest of the estate.
2. `NARRATIVE_RELATION` — where it sits on the whole-estate narrative continuity map.
3. `ORIENTATION_RELATION` — how the route inherits Compass orientation without competing with it.
4. `DISPLAY_ROLE` — the visual job of the surface: orient, arrive, explain, prove, explore, transact, discover, return, or another bounded role.
5. `RUNTIME_CEILING` — L0 through L4, with justification.
6. `PERSISTENT_OBJECTS` — which semantic objects, if any, should survive movement and why.
7. `TRANSITION_MEANING` — what each major transition communicates beyond decoration.
8. `PROGRESSIVE_DISCLOSURE` — what information stays immediate and what waits for user intent.
9. `MOBILE_COMPOSITION` — how the route changes composition on tablet and phone.
10. `REDUCED_MOTION_EQUIVALENCE` — how complete meaning survives reduced-motion preference.
11. `RETURN_CONTRACT` — where explicit orientation recovery is provided.
12. `CLAIM_BOUNDARY` — what visual emphasis is forbidden from implying.
13. `LOCAL_VISUAL_IDENTITY` — which visual features must remain distinct so the room does not collapse into a universal template.
14. `CONTINUITY_HOOK` — which identity, state, route, or expectation must survive later evolution.

A route may not be called display-ready if these questions are materially unresolved.

## Compass / Door / Home constitutional family

The first reference family is:

`COMPASS -> DOOR -> HOME`

with a discovery layer behind the map.

### Compass

Role: `PROVE_ORIENTATION`.

Compass establishes space and global direction. It should remain elegant rather than becoming the estate directory. Manor may exceed Compass in topology density while remaining subordinate in narrative authority.

### Door

Role: `PROVE_THRESHOLD_CONTINUITY`.

Door is a transformation operator:

`ORIENTATION -> THRESHOLD -> ARRIVAL`

Door inherits Compass direction. It does not invent directional meaning, classify the whole estate, or become another directory.

### Home

Role: `PROVE_ARRIVAL_AND_RETURN`.

`COMPASS = ORIENTATION_CENTER`

`HOME = ESTATE_HEART_AND_RETURN_CENTER`

Home should communicate where the visitor came from, what can be resumed, how to return to orientation, and what Home itself is for.

### Hidden door

Role: `PROVE_DISCOVERY_WITHOUT_MAP_CORRUPTION`.

`DISCOVERY_REVEALS_DEPTH_NOT_ANOTHER_DIRECTION`

Mirrorland or game access discovered behind the Compass must not be represented as a fifth or sixth cardinal direction.

## Aesthetic direction

The estate should avoid generic luxury-WebGL imitation. The preferred whole-estate display direction is:

`TACTILE_CARTOGRAPHIC_REALISM + DIGITAL_INSTRUMENTATION + CINEMATIC_SPATIAL_CONTINUITY`

This is a design direction, not a mandatory skin. Local rooms may remain typographic, documentary, naturalistic, game-like, scientific, commercial, or narrative when their role requires it.

## Mandatory AI-entry behavior

For every repository project, the AI entry process must load this constitution as global development context when the task includes any of the following:

- new public page or material public-page renewal;
- frontier, product, room, world, campaign, or showroom construction;
- navigation, transition, persistent-object, interaction, or responsive-composition work;
- shared visual-system or estate-shell work;
- any task claiming estate-wide display coherence or continuity.

For non-visual backend/control-plane work, the constitution is still discoverable global context but does not create irrelevant visual work or expand mutation scope.

Project-specific entrypoints, nested instructions, scientific/evidence boundaries, and existing runtime authority remain controlling inside their own domains.

## Fail-closed conditions

Stop or return `REVIEW_REQUIRED` before display construction when any of the following is unresolved and material to the task:

- a route claims a competing global orientation meaning;
- a transition visually implies an incorrect narrative relationship;
- runtime level exceeds its justified ceiling without route-specific authority;
- mobile or reduced-motion semantics are missing;
- a hidden/discovery route mutates the public cardinal map;
- visual emphasis would create or upgrade a claim;
- a proposed universal shell would erase necessary local identity;
- a deep route lacks explicit return;
- a new surface cannot locate itself on the narrative continuity map.

This constitution supplies mandatory context and constraints. It never grants project mutation, merge, deployment, scientific, product, renderer, or claim authority.
